name: Apprise Api
composeYaml:
services:
  apprise-api:
    image: 'linuxserver/apprise-api:latest'
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=UTC
    volumes:
      - '/apprise-api/config:/config'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:8000/'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
